## About
Ogany Collision Center is a body shop in the heart of Pasadena, on East Orange Grove Boulevard. We handle auto body and collision repair, paintless dent removal, paint protection and towing, and we proudly service the California Highway Patrol.
The shop is run by Vic Oganesyan, an auto body shop owner and operator who learned the trade from his father and grandfather. He uses state of the art collision repair products and procedures while keeping the old fashioned values he was taught.
Our factory trained technicians use the finest automotive repair and refinish products, and we stand behind the work with a lifetime warranty for as long as you own your vehicle.

## Services
- Collision repair: Factory quality collision repair using the finest automotive repair and refinish products.
- Auto body repair: Body work for cars that have been hit, scraped or creased, from fenders to doors.
- Paintless dent removal: Dent removal is on our service list. Call and ask whether it fits your car.

## FAQ
Q: Is the repair covered by a warranty?
A: Yes. We offer a lifetime warranty for as long as you own your vehicle.
